issues.failure_explanation: Membership in the enhanced space W̃_{k+2}(K) requires (v − Π^∇_{k+2}v, q) = 0 for every q ∈ 𝒫_{k+2}(K) ∖ 𝒫_k(K). A bubble b ∈ ℬ_{k+2∖k}(K) satisfies b ⊥ 𝒫_{k-2}(K) in L² only; its L² inner products against monomials of degree k+1 and k+2 are unconstrained, so (b − Π^∇_{k+2}b, q) ≠ 0 in general for q ∈ 𝒫_{k+2} ∖ 𝒫_k. Consequently the direct sum V_k(K) = W̃_k² ⊕ ℬ_{k+2∖k}² is not contained in [W̃_{k+2}(K)]² and the claimed inclusion is false.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the false inclusion with a correct unisolvence argument: since V_k(K) = W̃_k² ⊕ ℬ_{k+2∖k}² and dofs(v)#1–#3 determine only ṽ while dofs(v)#4 determines only b̂_h (the two sets of dofs act on orthogonal components of the direct sum), the combined degrees of freedom are unisolvent for V_k(K).
issues.overall_effect: The sole stated justification for unisolvence of the velocity degrees of freedom (prop:added-4) rests on the false inclusion and is invalid as written. The unisolvence claim itself remains true and is recoverable by a direct argument.
issues.title: False set inclusion V_k(K) ⊂ [W̃_{k+2}(K)]² used to justify unisolvence
issues.why_classification: A short, local replacement of the false justification by a direct unisolvence argument preserves every substantive claim and guarantee with no new nontrivial lemma or construction.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof bounds a_h^K(v_h,v_h) by C⋆ a^K(v_h,v_h) − a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) and then asserts this is ≤ C⋆ a^K(v_h,v_h). This requires a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) ≥ 0. However, a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) = a^K(ṽ, b̂_h) = ∫ ∇ṽ : ∇b̂_h, which is indefinite: choosing ṽ = −b̂_h ∈ V_k(K) with b̂_h ≠ 0 gives a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) = −|b̂_h|²_1 < 0. The dropped term is therefore positive and the inequality C⋆ a^K(v_h,v_h) − a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) ≤ C⋆ a^K(v_h,v_h) is false in general.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the dropped-term step with a valid bound: write a_h^K(v_h,v_h) ≤ max(1,α⋆) a^K(ṽ,ṽ) + max(1,β♯γ⋆) a^K(b̂_h,b̂_h) and then invoke the splitting stability of prop:added-3 (|ṽ|_1 + |b̂_h|_1 ≤ C|v_h|_1) to conclude a_h^K(v_h,v_h) ≤ C a^K(v_h,v_h). Equivalently, apply Young's inequality to 2a^K(Q^∇_k ṽ, b̂_h) and absorb it into the stabilisation terms.
issues.overall_effect: The upper bound in the stability equivalence C⋆ a(v,v) ≤ a_h(v,v) ≤ C⋆ a(v,v) is unproved. Every result that invokes the stability of a_h — continuity and coercivity (prop:cont-cor), well-posedness of the discrete problem (thm:added-2), and the energy- and L²-norm error estimates (thm:est, thm:added-3, cor:added-1) — becomes unreliable.
issues.title: Prop:stab upper-bound proof drops an indefinite cross term as if it were non-negative
issues.why_classification: The proof gap requires a contained nontrivial argument (invoking prop:added-3 or Young with absorption) rather than a one-line correction, but no new global proof architecture is needed and every guarantee and rate survives once the argument is supplied.

issues.failure_explanation: Because Q⁰_k = Id − Π⁰_k, the form c_h(q_h,q_h) = Σ_K S_p^K(Q⁰_k q_h, Q⁰_k q_h) vanishes on every q_h ∈ 𝒫_k ⊂ Q_k (since Q⁰_k q_h = 0). For any nonzero q_h ∈ 𝒫_k(K) ⊂ Q_k(K) one obtains c_h(q_h,q_h) = 0 < δ⋆ ‖q_h‖²_{0,Ω}, contradicting the stated lower bound. The correct lower bound is δ⋆ ‖Q⁰_k q_h‖²_{0,Ω} ≤ c_h(q_h,q_h), which controls only the non-polynomial part of q_h.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof consists of one sentence citing Theorem 4.5 of guo2020new. The discrete setting differs from that paper: the velocity space has a direct-sum structure W̃_k² ⊕ ℬ_{k+2∖k}², the bilinear form a_h uses two projector levels Π^∇_k and Π^∇_{k+2}, and the pressure stabilisation α c_h acts only on Q⁰_k q_h. The non-trivial verification that the cited theorem's hypotheses — in particular that the weak inf-sup of prop:added-6 and the coercivity of a_h from prop:stab satisfy the required saddle-point stability conditions in this modified setting — is entirely absent. As written the proof supplies no mathematical content supporting the asserted inf-sup condition and continuity of B_h.

failure_location.quote: The result is proved by adapting~\cite[Theorem 4.5]{guo2020new}.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Provide a proof of the inf-sup and continuity of B_h by explicitly adapting [guo2020new, Theorem 4.5]: verify that the weak inf-sup of prop:added-6, the coercivity of a_h from prop:stab, and the upper bound of c_h satisfy the hypotheses of the cited theorem in the MINI-VEM setting, and carry out the saddle-point stability argument to obtain the stated inf-sup for B_h.
issues.overall_effect: The inf-sup condition and continuity of B_h are unproved. Consequently, existence and uniqueness of the discrete solution (thm:added-2) and all error estimates (thm:est, thm:added-3, cor:added-1) lose their key stability input and become unreliable.
issues.title: Well-posedness of B_h proved only by a bare external citation
